title: Framework/PBC compact-support and open-exchange comparison
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type between quasi-separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$ be a quasi-compact open immersion, and put $X_V=X\times_YV$, with projections $u:X_V\hookrightarrow X$ and $f_V:X_V\to V$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-open-immersion]. Supply a compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow T,p:T\to Y)$, with $j$ quasi-compact open and $p$ proper, and its pullback $c_V$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. No separatedness of any of these schemes over $k$ is assumed. Every scheme just named is required to be Noetherian, meaning quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and to have finite Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].

For each finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Omega$, write $R=\mathcal O_E$, choose a uniformizer $\varpi$, and put $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. At the integral stage let $\mathcal C_T$ be the framework derived-complete constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and $\mathcal P_T$ the PBC bounded constructible complete category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Let $J_T:\mathcal C_T\simeq\mathcal P_T$ be the coefficient-presentation equivalence inverse to $\Phi_{E,T}$ of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport], restricted to these full categories. At $E$ and $\Omega$ use exactly its raw rationalized and common-stage equivalences of [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison]. In the formulas below $J$ and the operations are taken at any one of these three stages.

Write $F_h^{\mathrm{sf}}$ for the framework compact-support functor of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], whose integral value is
$$F_f^{\mathrm{sf}}K=R\!\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n Rp_{*,A_n}j_!(K\otimes_R^LA_n),$$
using its specified strict quotient transitions, and write $F_h^{\mathrm{pbc}}=Rp_*j_!$ for the completed PBC functor [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification], with raw rationalization and common-stage passage at field coefficients. Here $h=f,f_V$. Write $P_a^{\mathrm{sf}}$ and $P_a^{\mathrm{pbc}}$ for the completed pullbacks along $a=u,v$, respectively [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and their field forms.

There are specified natural isomorphisms
$$b_h:J_{\operatorname{target}(h)}F_h^{\mathrm{sf}}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_h^{\mathrm{pbc}}J_{\operatorname{source}(h)},\qquad a_s:J_{\operatorname{source}(s)}P_s^{\mathrm{sf}}\xrightarrow{\sim}P_s^{\mathrm{pbc}}J_{\operatorname{target}(s)}\quad(s=u,v).$$
Their integral normalization is the identity of the whole strict reduction diagrams, followed by the canonical proper-direct-image/derived-limit and completed-open-extension/derived-limit comparisons. At field coefficients they are the scalar-localized and common-stage images with the specified coefficient associators.

Let $\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{sf}}:P_v^{\mathrm{sf}}F_f^{\mathrm{sf}}\to F_{f_V}^{\mathrm{sf}}P_u^{\mathrm{sf}}$ be the framework exchange formed on that same strict quotient diagram: first the proper adjunction mate, then the open adjunction comparison, followed by total derived inverse limit and the canonical endpoint identifications. Let $\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{pbc}}$ be precisely the ordered completed exchange [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], and its specified rationalized/common-stage forms. For every input $K\in\mathcal C_X$, put
$$S_K=P_v^{\mathrm{pbc}}(b_{f,K})\circ a_{v,F_f^{\mathrm{sf}}K},\qquad T_K=F_{f_V}^{\mathrm{pbc}}(a_{u,K})\circ b_{f_V,P_u^{\mathrm{sf}}K}.$$
Then the equality of actual natural transformations is
$$\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{J_XK}\circ S_K=T_K\circ J_V(\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{sf}}_K).$$
These identifications are natural for isomorphisms of the entire compactification/open-square diagram, including semilinear field automorphisms, respect identity and iterated open restriction, and commute with finite coefficient-field extension and its associators. If the diagram is defined over $k_0$, they identify the induced geometric-Frobenius Weil structures [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. The assertion compares the specified functors and arrows; it does not assert base-change invertibility.

source.place: Common-stage descent of the compact-support exchange; auxiliary comparison of the framework reduction-tower construction with the completed PBC construction, made explicit for open target restriction
